name: Daytimer
summary: A daytimer, sometimes called a daytime rave or Bhangra Do, is a type of rave which was popular with young South Asian British people during the late 1980s and early 1990s.
description: A daytimer, sometimes called a daytime rave or Bhangra Do, is a type of rave which was popular with young South Asian British people during the late 1980s and early 1990s. Daytimers predominantly featured bhangra music played by live bands or DJs, but also spanned various other dance genres. They were held during the daytime in order to accommodate their young South Asian audience, to whom nightlife was not readily accessible as a result of cultural norms and racist treatment. Daytimers took place in cities across England, with some of the most prominent daytimer cultures in Birmingham, Bradford and West London.
